steps.title: Audit all ISB adapter resolution sites + maps + enum EnumMembers
Audit adapter identity in adapters repo (Glossary + *Identification.cs, collectors + indicators)
Harvest real-world name permutations from integrationsData.js (seed) + cybiIntegrationSetting.csv (live), keyed by `name`
Build complete (name, topic) -> (PlatformType, Category) identification profile; flag collisions, orphan names, unregistered adapters
Decide + document collision policy (Cisco duplicate EnumMember; Custom/Taegis; missing fallback aliases)
Implement single resolver owning (name, topic) -> (PlatformType, Category); idempotent, total
Simplify ProductPlatformMapper + VendorPlatformResolver to delegate; converge RegisteredAdapterPlatformResolver/FallbackPlatforms + other sites; retire duplicate maps
Add catalog->registration contract test (every live `name` resolves to a served (PlatformType, Category))
If adapters-repo changes needed: create branch first, then align
Build + test both repos on non-default branches
